column2: Complete all REQUIRED fields. Delete rows 1-3 before loading. Cost Centers must be loaded before any transactional data that references them as worktags.
Cost_Center_ID must be unique — recommend using legacy cost center code
Cost_Center_Hierarchy: Must match an existing Workday Cost Center Hierarchy name in your tenant
Availability_Date: Date from which this cost center is active, typically project or fiscal year start
Inactive_Date: Leave blank for active cost centers. Populate only for cost centers being retired at go-live.
Worktag_Only: TRUE if this cost center is used only as a worktag (not a full org hierarchy node), FALSE otherwise
Load order: Object 2 — load after Ledger Accounts, before Suppliers/Customers/Invoices
